caption: The wall switch in a dark hallway is flipped up, and the ceiling light comes on.

sa.check: A wall switch in a hallway; the hallway is dark at the start.
The switch is flipped: it moves to its other position.
The light is a ceiling fixture.
The order is dark, flip, lit.

pc.expect: The light comes on at the moment the switch moves, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch flips and the light stays off; or the light comes on before the switch is touched; or it comes on well after the flip with nothing else happening; or it comes on while the switch is untouched.

pc.expect: Once on, the light stays on steadily and the hallway stays lit for the rest of the clip.
pc.fail: The light goes off again by itself; or flickers on and off after the flip; or dims back to dark; or the switch moves back by itself.

pc.expect: When the light is on, the hallway is lit from the ceiling fixture: walls and floor below it are brighter than before, with shadows pointing away from it.
pc.fail: The fixture glows but the hallway stays dark; or the hallway brightens while the fixture stays dark; or the light comes from a place other than the fixture.

pc.expect: Nothing else in the hallway moves or changes when the switch is flipped.
pc.fail: Doors open, objects move or the hallway layout changes at the flip; or the switch plate moves along the wall.

pc.expect: One switch and one ceiling light; the switch stays on the wall and the fixture on the ceiling.
pc.fail: A second switch or light appears; or the fixture vanishes or moves across the ceiling; or the switch sinks into the wall; or the hand passes through the switch.

pc.expect: The wall colour, fixture design and hallway contents stay the same apart from the lighting.
pc.fail: The wall changes colour rather than brightness; or the fixture changes shape; or pictures on the wall change.
